text:
jamie: heads up — deploy-bot started a staggered rollout for charts/payment-service v1.12.5 into prod/payments (deploy-bot ping)

deploy-bot: rolling out release payment-service-20251102 to prod/payments canary pool (instances: 3). preflight checks passed.

arjun: saw spike in schema-checker logs during post-upgrade hook on canary, looks like pg subchart bumped minor. logs:
```
helm upgrade --install payment-service ./charts/payment-service --namespace prod/payments --values values.prod.yaml --set image.tag=1.12.5
Error: post-upgrade hook failed: Job batch/v1 "migrate-db" failed: CrashLoopBackOff
kubectl logs job/migrate-db -n prod/payments
pq: column "currency" of relation "invoices" does not exist
```
so it's a migrations vs schema mismatch.

sofia: where did the chart come from? repo shows chart v1.12.5 introduced pg 13->14 bump without migration for invoices.currency.

marina: can we pin back to 1.12.4 for canary and abort global? this is outside the scheduled change window.

kevin: +1 to abort. avoid live rollbacks in payments during peak hours.

jamie: agree. @deploy-bot abort global rollout and rollback canary to 1.12.4. we need release notes and a coordinated change window. who owns release notes?

sofia: I'll draft release notes: "hotfix: postpone pg upgrade for payments due to missing invoice.currency migration. Reverted to chart v1.12.4. Follow-up: schedule migration window and add DB migration test in staging."

arjun: ops note: apply chart pin in HelmRelease to lock the canary: 
```
spec:
  chart:
    spec:
      version: "1.12.4"
  valuesFrom:
    - configMapKeyRef:
        name: payments-values
        key: prod
```

marina: also patch deploy-bot policy to skip auto-rollouts outside change windows for the payments namespace:
`deploy-bot set-policy prod/payments auto-rollout: false`

deploy-bot: acknowledged. global rollout aborted. canary rollback initiated.

deploy-bot: rollback complete for payment-service-20251102 in prod/payments/canary (3 nodes). monitoring 5m.

kevin: monitoring dashboards look stable. no error spike now.

jamie: ok, next steps — (1) sofia publish release notes; (2) arjun create migration runbook + staging test; (3) ops schedule change window 2025-11-03 02:00-04:00 UTC; (4) do not resume auto-rollout until migration validated.

sofia: will publish now and ping #product-notices. draft snippet:
"Reverted payment-service chart to v1.12.4 due to DB migration gap. Migration will be scheduled off-peak (2025-11-03 02:00 UTC). No customer action required."

marina: filed change window in calendar and added on-call rotation. ticket INFRA-1298 created.

jamie: thanks. closing thread — re-open if rollback shows issues. :white_check_mark:
